info.description: The full-bleed closing band. ⚠ The scrim, the float ornament and the reveal delays are design and stay in the page.

headingLines.description: One line of the heading per entry. The page puts the breaks in and sets the last line in italic.

quote.description: The closing line. Some pages set it as a quotation with a name under it; some as a plain sentence. The page decides which.

quoteAuthor.description: Leave empty to credit the Principal named in Site Settings.

imageAlt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.
